_readme: No verified partner or client list was available when this site was built — do NOT invent company names. Each item below is a real logo slot with an editable placeholder name. Once you have a verified, permitted-to-display partner: replace 'name' with the real company name, drop their logo into /assets/images/partners/ using the same filename (or update 'logo'), and re-run scripts/build_site.py. To add partner #7, copy one object inside 'items' and give it a unique logo.
